meta.name: pathfinder
meta.description: Map a codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts, identify duplicated concerns across features, and propose a unified architecture. Use when asked to "find the ideal path," unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor. Emits a proposed unified flowchart plus per-system /make-plan prompts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将代码库映射为功能流程图，识别重复并统一架构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在重构或统一多个重复系统
copy.tagline_en: Map codebase into feature flowcharts, identify duplicates, and unify architecture
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are refactoring or unifying duplicated systems

howto.what: 它会分析代码库,按功能画流程图、找出重复问题,提出最简统一架构,并输出可直接交给 /make-plan 的改造提示。它不写代码,只做规划和交接。
howto.when: 当你说出“找到理想路径”“统一重复系统”或“重构前审计架构”时触发。

say.text: 帮我找出这个项目里重复的代码逻辑
say.note: 会生成重复报告并给出统一方案。

say.text: 重构前先审计一下当前架构
say.note: 会产出流程图和统一提案。

say.text: 给这个仓库做一次功能分组和流程图
say.note: 会生成特征清单和流程图。

howto.what_en: It analyzes the codebase, maps features into flowcharts, identifies duplicated concerns, proposes the simplest unified architecture, and outputs ready-to-use /make-plan prompts. It does not write implementation code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when asked to 'find the ideal path', unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor.

say_en.text: Find duplicated code logic in this project
say_en.note: Generates a duplication report and unified plan.
Produces flowcharts and a unified proposal.

say_en.text: Map features and flowcharts for this repo
say_en.note: Creates a feature inventory and per-feature flowcharts.
